WMS Workflow
First we need to do some basic configuration:
• We need to enable some master from report rights.
• QR/Barcode Master setup.
• Stationary master.
• Scan option required for GRN/GDI(Permission).
• Duplicate print (permission).
• Enable Roll ASN Against Movement Article(Inventory setting >>company Setup)
• Site location(Report Right(To generate QR for Sites))
• Once this master are enable we need to define QR Code/ Barcode master setup.
In the bellow mention setup we need to define for what transaction we need to generate the QR Code.
• Need to enable Quick Docs from Translation configurator.
Need to enable quick docs for all the transaction we want to do on mobile application.
As shown bellow:
Once all the major configuration is done we can start using the WMS
(Note: Build 2025_01 should be deployed on server and to download mobile app use this link: WFXQuickDocs_0407_01.apk)
Things which you can perform using WMS open on mobile application.
• GRN.
• Dispatch(GDI pick list creation, GDN).
• GON.
• GIN.
• Location management (If you want to change the location of your stock).
• Smart scan(Shows full details of the roll , Also help in splitting the roll if required).
Bellow mention GRN type can be done by Application
• Production Process order input return
• ASN from supplier- Against ASN
• Buyer order return.
• Process order input return -against PO
• Returnable transfer out of system.
• Transfer from site- External.
• Transfer from site internal
To make the GRN from mobile application for RMPO you need to either use supplier portal or create a supplier ASN against the RMPO so that QR code can be generated.
Once QR code will be generated you can scan that QR in mobile application to do the GRN.
• Enable Roll ASN Against Movement Article(Inventory setting >>company Setup)
Above mention setting should be enable to generate QR on ASN as roll movement will be enable in the ASN
Mobile Application.
After downloading the application bellow interface will be open where you need to fill some details like:
• User name (same as which you are using in the desktop)
• Password (same as which you are using in the desktop)
• Company ID(same as which you are using in the desktop)
• URL (same as which you are using in the desktop)
Once all the details are fill click on next button
IF you want to do grn for receipt type asn from supplier against PO in App then you need to create ASN if not then do the grn directly on UI your QR code will get generated which you can print and attach on the rolls after that you can use that QR while doing production.
Then you get option to make pin or use biometric for login next time as shown bellow.
Creation of GRN>>
• Click on GRN.
• Select receipt type.
• Select site.
• Select supplier
• Asn number/FPPO number/GIN number/PRPO number/GDN number( As per GRN receipt type)
Scan the QR from source then do the grn.
Location>>
Path: Inventory > Stock Management > Update Shade / Location
Existing Functionality: Currently WFX is supporting to change material location by manually entering the data in application.
With the help of mobile application user will be able to change location of stock via. Mobile App.
Location tab is used for change of location if you have received your stock at Location A in Site XYZ but you need to move the stock to next location then you can you this module to change the location.
Once you change the location using Mobile application one auto transaction will be created in system In Site location management.(Path>> Inventory >> Site location Management.)
• Step 1 click on location tab.
• Select the site.
• Select the roll by scanning the QR.
• Select the Location by Scanning the QR(path >> Inventory >> Codes >> Site-Location)
• Click on Confirm.
Once you click on site location you need to select site then select any particular location for which you want to generate QR then click on generate QR which you can print and paste in your location for future use.
Dispatch>>
Existing Functionality: Currently WFX is supporting to create GDI pick list and GDN from Web application Only.
With the help of mobile application user will be able to create GDI pick list and make GDN directly from Mobile App.
Dispatch tab is used for creating GDI pick list and Dispatch.
Once dispatch is created with mobile application one auto transaction will be created in the web under dispatch screen.
• Step 1 click on dispatch icon.
• Select the site.
• Select GDI number.
• Click on article
• Scan the roll from GRN or QC(If QC is done)
• Click on ok.
• Click on confirm Picklist has been created.
• Once GDI has been created click on GDN.
• Select the site.
• Select GDI
• Fill the details
• Confirm the GDN
GDI WORKFLOW>>
GDN> Workflow
Smart Scan>>
Existing Functionality: Currently WFX is supporting to split the from stock movement split.
With the help of mobile application user will be able Split the roll on mobile app also he we be able to see the full details of roll.
Smart scan tab is used to make transaction for roll split also you can see the detail of roll like:
Location.
Wfx Stock movement Number.
Stock Movement Number.
Article Name(Article Code)
Colour/ Size
Lot/ Shade
Qty
Buyer
Style
And if we click on stock movement number we can see other additional details.
The transaction which you made in Smart scan will be created in Inventory>> WFX Stock Movement list.
Steps to use Smart Scan:
• Select Smart Scan
• Scan the roll.
• Split the qty.
• Confirm.
Created by Rohit Singh
